Lumenwave

Staff Data Engineer

New York, NY · Remote OK

About Lumenwave

Lumenwave builds developer-tools for ML training pipelines. We help over 600 teams reduce their training-cluster cost and time-to-iteration. Our customers include three of the largest open-source AI labs and several Fortune-500 companies.

About the role

As a Staff Data Engineer, you'll own the data platform that ingests, transforms, and serves billions of training-run telemetry events per day. You'll be the technical lead for a team of 6 engineers and partner with our research customers on new data products.

What you'll do

  • Architect and operate the data platform: Kafka, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow
  • Lead the technical direction of the data team; mentor 6 engineers
  • Partner with ML researchers on novel data products and APIs
  • Own data quality, lineage, and observability across the platform
  • Drive cost-reduction initiatives for our cloud spend

About you

  • 8+ years of professional data engineering experience
  • Strong Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala or Java
  • Production experience with Apache Kafka, Spark, or Flink
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and growing teams
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with ML infrastructure or training pipelines
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and Terraform
  • Open-source contributions to data tooling
  • Experience with Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi

Compensation

$220,000 - $280,000 base depending on location, plus equity. Full benefits, 401(k) match, and home-office stipend.

Authorization

Lumenwave will sponsor work authorization for exceptional candidates. We are an equal-opportunity employer.
